runtime.actorGone: The tunnel service does not respond. Restart the app and check the log.
runtime.noLastStart: No parameters of a previous start: turn protection on again.
runtime.previousNotStopped: Could not confirm that the previous VPN runtime stopped. Stop protection again and check the log.
runtime.proxyAddressInvalid: Invalid upstream proxy address. Use host:port or [IPv6]:port; the port must be between 1 and 65535.
runtime.proxyNotListening: Proxy {{addr}} is unreachable. Make sure Happ runs in Proxy mode and listens on this port.
runtime.profileUnusable: This VPN profile cannot run in sing-box. Check the key or choose another server.
runtime.egressUnknown: Could not determine the external IP through the tunnel.
runtime.fullStopRan: A full stop already ran; protection cannot be considered preserved
runtime.stopIncomplete: Turning protection off did not complete. Stop protection again and check the network diagnostics.
runtime.restartStopFailed: Could not stop the previous VPN runtime during the protected restart. Stop protection again and check the log.
runtime.switchUnconfirmed: The new server did not confirm internet access through the tunnel.

tunSetup.adapter: The tunnel interface did not come up. The start was cancelled to prevent a traffic leak.
tunSetup.protection: The kill switch was not confirmed. The start was cancelled.
tunSetup.routes: Could not confirm that the TUN interface was created and protected. The start was cancelled; details are in the log.

cleanup.exitUnproven: The VPN runtime exit was not confirmed; network protection is kept. Stop protection again and check the log.
cleanup.xray: The xray-core exit was not confirmed; protection is kept. Stop again and check the log.
cleanup.protection: The kill-switch firewall rules were not removed. Stop protection again and check the network diagnostics.

watchdog.proxyDown: Proxy {{addr}} does not respond. Traffic is held inside the TUN so it cannot leak past the VPN.
watchdog.upstreamDown: The VPN through server «{{name}}» is not confirmed. Traffic stays inside the TUN (your real IP does not leak). Check the connection or choose another server.
watchdog.slotExited: The server's xray-core exited; restarting it. Traffic stays inside the TUN.
